What we do

Five trades, one site organisation

From trench to road surface, from micropile to roof: every stage is carried out by our own site managers, foremen and fleet.

Water networks

Drinking water supply, wastewater and stormwater networks, connections and ancillary structures.

Roads and asphalt

Milling, paving and compaction, day or night, with our own asphalt crew and plant.

Utilities and earthworks

Roads, utilities, pavements, verges and public space development.

Special works

Commitments

Safety, quality, environment, deadlines

These are our priorities on every site. They rest on continuous training for our teams and on equipment we control.

Safety

First-aid at work, utility proximity (AIPR) certification, work at height, temporary signage and full PPE.

Quality

Technical supervision on every project and deadlines met, including emergency works.

Environment

Clean sites, runoff management and prevention of damage to existing networks.

Local roots

A Guadeloupe company investing in local skills and employment.

Our commitments
